nodes.name: h-WNRAs Hydrothermal Synthesis
nodes.procedure: The FTO glass substrates (1 × 5 cm2 in size, 10-14 Ω cm-2, 90% optical transmittance) were rinsed in the order of acetone, alcohol and de-ionized water for 10 min each. And then they were dried and covered with a TiO2 seed layer on the conductive surface, aiming at strengthening the adhesion between the substrates and subsequent nanorods. In the meantime, a solution was prepared by adding 8.25 g Na2WO4·2H2O to 25 mL deionized water, which was then stirred and adjusted by adding HCl (2 mol L-1) drop by drop until its pH value reached 2. Afterwards, the solution was diluted to 250 mL with de-ionized water and then its pH value was adjusted to 2 again by adding a shade of H2C2O4. And thus, the precursor solution was obtained. Subsequently, in order to grow WO3 nanorod arrays over the TiO2 seed layer, the FTO substrate (seed layer facing the bottom) and 20 mL of precursor solution were transferred to a Teflon-lined autoclave (50 mL in size), while bits of Rb2SO4 (0.67 g) were also poured into the autoclave to control the length and diameter of the nanorods. Then the autoclave was put into an incubator and heated at 180°C for 5 h. When the reaction was complete, the autoclave was taken out and naturally cooled to room temperature. After that, the FTO substrate was removed and cleaned with de-ionized water more than three times. Ultimately, the as-synthesized h-WNRAs on the FTO substrate were dried in air for further experiments.

nodes.description: Electrochromic performance in 1 M AlCl3 aqueous electrolyte
nodes.source_text: The material showed a high optical modulation 81.5%... low coloring (9 s) and bleaching (14 s) time... high CE of 149.9 cm² C⁻¹ at 800 nm... coulombic efficiency of 89.3% even at an extremely low scan rate of 2 mV s⁻¹... normalized capacity could still retain 90.6%... 80% compared with the initial value... only 1.5% decay and a 0.3% increase of the transmittance

nodes.description: Supercapacitor performance in 1 M AlCl3 aqueous electrolyte
nodes.source_text: specific capacitance of 235.4 F g⁻¹ at 1 A g⁻¹... at 10 A g⁻¹ still showed a retention of 58.2%... optical modulation tested at 10 A g⁻¹ still showed a retention of 79.4%... galvanostatic test at 5 A g⁻¹ for 4000 cycles... retained a high specific capacitance, about 86.2%

nodes.description: Cyclic voltammetry stability at 50 mV/s for 1000 cycles
nodes.source_text: the normalized capacity could still retain 90.6% of the initial value... the coulombic efficiency retained a high value (close to 100%) in all 1000 cycles

nodes.source_text: the normalized capacity of the h-WNRAs still held a high value of 80%... the coulombic efficiency increased... to 99.4%

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows uniformly ordered nanorods perpendicular to the substrate with overall average length of about 500 nm and diameters between 70-100 nm (85 nm average for >90% of 1000 nanorods).
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Fig. 1a, the sample displayed a uniformly ordered arrangement of nanorods perpendicular to the substrate, which could also be confirmed by the cross-sectional SEM image of the sample (Fig. 1b). Obviously, the overall average length of nanorods is about 500 nm, while the diameters could be calculated from the statistics (inset of Fig. 1a), and the results show that more than 90% of the nanorods (total 1000) have a diameter between 70 and 100 nm (85 nm for the average size)

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows lattice spacing of 0.39 nm corresponding to hexagonal WO3 (001) lattice plane, confirming nanorods grow along [001] direction.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As indicated in the TEM image (Fig. 1c), the lattice spacing of a single nanorod was observed to be 0.39 nm, corresponding to that of hexagonal WO3 in its (001) lattice plane

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD confirms hexagonal phase of the nanorods.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Moreover, the XRD results further confirmed that the nanorods possess a hexagonal phase (Fig. 1e)

properties.description: XPS spectrum showing peaks for W 4f, W 4d

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS shows W 4f7/2 at 35.8 eV, W 4f5/2 at 37.9 eV, and W 5p3/2 at 41.5 eV, confirming all W atoms in nanorods exist as W^6+.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the three peaks have a good separation located at 35.8 eV, 37.9 eV and 41.5 eV, corresponding to W 4f7/2, W 4f5/2 and W 5p3/2, respectively. These values are consistent with those reported in previous literature, confirming that all the W atoms in nanorods exist in the form of W^6+.
